title: Autonomy with engineering control
intro: Autonomous does not mean unrestricted. Agents reason independently while execution remains governed by explicit technical and business rules.

rules.title: No unrestricted DB access
rules.text: Agents use governed backend/API tools only.

rules.title: No invented schema
rules.text: Factory works from repository and database truth.

rules.title: Tenant isolation
rules.text: companyId comes from authenticated context, never from an LLM.

rules.title: Auditability
rules.text: Important decisions and tool actions are logged.

rules.title: Money is approval-controlled
rules.text: Financial movements always stay behind approval.
